subtitle: Writer and walking guide
intro: Essays about the city, and small-group walks for people who want the long way through a neighborhood.
about: Jonah writes during the week and leads walks on Saturday mornings. Groups stay under eight so the route can change when the conversation does.

offerings.detail: Two hours downhill, with stops for the buildings people walk past every day.

offerings.detail: How a neighborhood shop decides what to put near the door.

offerings.title: A commissioned essay
